agentgc builds from source or from the archives below. Each archive holds the binary, the README and the license. Check the `.sha256` file next to it.

Platforms:
- Windows is the tested platform.
- Linux and macOS archives are built and tested by GitHub Actions only. Nobody has run them by hand yet. Report problems in an issue.

agentgc prints a plan first and asks before it deletes. Run `agentgc clean --dry-run` before the first real clean.
